definition.meaning: Complete primary endpoint follow-up includes first primary event, non-CV death (including undetermined death under this SAP), or complete event assessment on/after PACD. Known vital status is insufficient for nonfatal endpoint completeness. Unknown event time/reasons do not erase a reported count of incomplete endpoint follow-up.

Do not substitute2/2 unknown vital statuses,444/442 drug discontinuations,5/5 nonreceivers or512/610 event counts for total unavailable primary-outcome extent.
Do not add overlapping categories or fabricate observed subgroup counts. Source-derived complementary availability is permissible if explicitly warranted.
